meta.source: Base44 app 'Staff Uniforms' (src/store/storefront.css) and storefront-kit brands/off-duty-hotel-club (theme.css, catalog.js, supply/crests/heritage), with the agreed improvements. Version 2 adds motion, focus, breakpoint, layout, ratio, z-index and print tokens, and phone sizes for the type styles.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere: header, sections, modals, the bag drawer.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: The background of every product photo, and the frame behind it, so the image has no visible edge. Never use it for text panels.

tokens.name: stone-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill on hotel cards and the quiet panel behind the editorial (winter) feature.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, the primary button fill and selected states. On paper, stone and stone-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: product descriptions, intros, accordion bodies. On paper, stone and stone-2 (5.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary copy on paper only: result counts, breadcrumbs, the preview note. 4.9:1 on paper; it falls below 4.5:1 on stone, so use ink-2 there.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between sections, card grids and accordion rows. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that must be seen: size buttons, quantity steppers, the search field underline. At least 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: staff-green
tokens.usage: The frame of the page only: announcement bar and footer. Never a section background in the middle of the page.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on staff-green and over the darkened hero photo (12:1 on staff-green).

tokens.name: on-dark-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on staff-green: the footer's small print (7.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hotel red, the one accent. Focus rings, the error message, the bag count when it is above zero. Never a button fill or a large block.

tokens.name: hotel-solvane
tokens.usage: Hôtel Solvane's ink: its crest, its number 01 and its name on hotel cards. Small accents only (5.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: hotel-oriole
tokens.usage: The Oriole Palace's ink: its crest, number 02 and name. Small accents only.

tokens.name: hotel-thalene
tokens.usage: Casa Thalene's ink: its crest, number 03 and name. Small accents only.

tokens.name: hotel-valbrune
tokens.usage: Grand Valbrune's ink: its crest, number 04 and name. Small accents only.

tokens.name: hotel-edelmatt
tokens.usage: Kurhaus Edelmatt's ink, gentian blue: its crest, number 05 and name. Small accents only (8.8:1 on paper).

tokens.name: garment-rescue-yellow
tokens.usage: Lifeguard shirt colour. Only in the 16px colour dot on the product page.

tokens.name: garment-washed-black
tokens.usage: Security shirt colour. Only in the colour dot.

tokens.name: garment-pool-blue
tokens.usage: Pool Boy shirt colour. Only in the colour dot.

tokens.name: garment-alpine-red
tokens.usage: Ski Patrol shirt colour. Only in the colour dot.

tokens.name: garment-garden-green
tokens.usage: Gardener shirt colour. Only in the colour dot. Deep enough that geranium ink reads on it (about 2.5:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and the bag drawer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero headline only, once per page. 56px on phones. The second line may be italic; nowhere else uses that pattern.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section and page titles, product names. 40px on phones. Roman, no full stop, no italic second line.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Modal and drawer titles, the empty-bag line, footer tagline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The poolside original. Proper rescue yellow and a small Riviera crest on the chest.
styles.usage: All running copy and product names on cards. Measure about 60 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: hotel under a product card, accordion bodies, the preview note.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and text links. The smallest size in the system: nothing is set below 12px.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only, in capitals, with HOTEL CLUB beneath it in wordmark-sub. 22px on phones. Cinzel is the crest family's inscription face; never use it for headings or copy.

styles.name: wordmark-sub
styles.usage: The second line of the wordmark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and the line it labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between size buttons; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Product card: photo to name.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; accordion row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between product cards on desktop; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section heading to content; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop (the playbook's 100–140px).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of sections on desktop, capped so content stays within 1500px.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, photos, inputs, modals. The brand is square-cornered like a printed card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only round things: the colour dot and the bag count.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The bag drawer sliding in from the right.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals: size guide, search, menu. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Every transition and animation. Nothing bounces or overshoots.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour changes on small controls: tabs, thumbnails, size buttons.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Photo hover scale, front-over-back fade, button darkening, drawer slide.

tokens.name: duration-slower
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals and the hero's first fade. The upper limit.

tokens.name: hover-scale
tokens.usage: Photos on hover. Never applied to buttons, text or cards as a whole.

tokens.name: reveal-distance
tokens.usage: How far a section rises as it fades in on scroll.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus outline on every interactive element.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the element and its focus outline (2px on thumbnails inside a tight grid).

tokens.name: focus-color
tokens.usage: The outline colour. Passes 3:1 on paper, stone and stone-2; on staff-green use on-dark.

tokens.name: phone
tokens.usage: Below this: single-column forms, full-width drawer, 12px grid gaps.

tokens.name: tablet
tokens.usage: Below this: mobile header and menu, two-column grids, stacked product page.

tokens.name: laptop
tokens.usage: Below this: gallery thumbnails move under the main image.

tokens.name: review-desktop
tokens.usage: Width every page is screenshotted and reviewed at.

tokens.name: review-phone
tokens.usage: Phone width every page is screenshotted and reviewed at.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest any content row runs. The gutter grows beyond it.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header bar on desktop; 64px below the tablet breakpoint.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Bag, search and preview drawers. Full width below the phone breakpoint.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of running copy.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Smallest height or width of anything that can be pressed.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Product grid columns on desktop; 2 below the tablet breakpoint. Hotel cards: 4 and 2.

tokens.name: ratio-product
tokens.usage: Every product photo, card, gallery image and thumbnail.

tokens.name: ratio-editorial
tokens.usage: Story and editorial photographs.

tokens.name: ratio-hero
tokens.usage: Hero fills the viewport minus the header (min 560px, max 920px). On phones it is cropped with mobileFocus 84% 50% so the back print reads in full.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind drawers and modals.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Bag, search, menu and preview drawers.

tokens.name: z-skip-link
tokens.usage: Skip link, above everything when focused.

print.note: Physical product tokens. Pantone references are to be confirmed against a swatch book and supplier strike-offs; until then they are marked tbc.

tokens.name: crest-max
tokens.usage: Largest dimension of a printed heritage crest (DTG). Security 70 x 85 mm, Ski Patrol 83 x 85 mm.

tokens.name: crest-placement
tokens.value: left chest, centred about 18cm below the shoulder seam
tokens.usage: Front crest position on the wearer's left.

tokens.name: crest-min-line
tokens.usage: Thinnest line that survives DTG on the sample shirts. Set it from the sample scorecard (crest sharpness row) before bulk production.

tokens.name: crest-min-cap-height
tokens.usage: Smallest cap height for crest text in print; 4.5mm for embroidery.

tokens.name: back-print-width
tokens.usage: Width of the job title across the shoulders (Anton), centred 80mm below the collar.

tokens.name: back-hotel-line
tokens.usage: The hotel name under the job title.

tokens.name: back-city-line
tokens.usage: The city under the hotel name.

tokens.name: ink-off-white
tokens.usage: Security ink on washed black.

tokens.name: ink-cream
tokens.usage: Ski Patrol ink on alpine red.

tokens.name: ink-geranium
tokens.usage: Gardener ink on garden green, crest and back. The red of window-box geraniums; kept bright so it holds about 2.5:1 on the green.

tokens.name: worn-ink
tokens.usage: Speckled knockout on large back prints, so less ink sits on the fabric and the print stays soft.
